description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Awoken Fire], [Damage Cap +10000], [Blacksmith's Daughter Mode] and [Battering Heat] to the user

description.name: Awoken Fire
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Blacksmith's Daughter Mode
description.text: Casts Fist of Kazus after using a Fire ability

description.name: Battering Heat
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire] after using two Fire abilities
